children: EQT expects to achieve $325 million in base annual synergies within two years of completing its Range Resources acquisition. The synergies come from corporate, operations, and commodities marketing, the company said. EQT also outlined a pathway to more than $600 million in long-term synergies from development optimization and improved margins across natural gas, LNG, and NGL marketing. The deal improves EQT's unlevered free cash flow breakeven to less than $2 per MMBtu. Cumulative free cash flow is projected at roughly $20 billion over the next five years at recent strip pricing
